narratives.Description: Deliver Module 6 as a self-directed lesson that turns horizontal activity lists into small end-to-end outcomes with observable evidence. This story is independently buildable because it is command-free and owns its lesson, exercise, explained solution, source trace, navigation, and focused content checks.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Revalidate the strategy, specification, proposed-scope, work-shaping, and decomposition claims against the pinned Directive 0.112.0 source, then author curriculum/modules/06-creating-well-shaped-work.md and solutions/module-06-creating-well-shaped-work.md with fictional planning exercises and outcome-mapped evidence.
2. Update the exact learner navigation and reference files, add scripts/verify-module-6.mjs plus negative unit tests, and run the focused npm checks and xBRIEF conformance check before the aggregate gate.
